text.en:
The organization and management of the said school shall be subject to the rules and regulations
to be issued by the Secretary of Health;

The sum of two hundred thousand pesos is hereby appropriated out of the funds of the National
Treasury, not otherwise appropriated to carry out the purposes of this decree for the current fiscal year.
Thereafter, such sum as may be necessary for the operation of the school shall be included in the General
Appropriations Decree.

This Decree shall take effect immediately.
Done in the City of Manila, this 11th day of June, in the year of Our Lord, nineteen hundred and
seventy-eight.
